set.Finding description: After organoid-debris challenge, human isogenic APOE33 microglia acidified from about pH 5.15 to 5.05 (*** vs untreated APOE33 in Fig 3G), whereas APOE44 microglia did not acidify significantly (ns vs untreated APOE44); debris-treated APOE44 late-endosomal/lysosomal pH was about 0.08 units higher than debris-treated APOE33 (about 5.13 vs 5.05, read from Fig 3G), with three wells per group.
set.Data location: Fig 3G, APOE33+debris vs APOE44+debris (also each vs its untreated genotype)

why: Fig 3G has a '*' bracket joining exactly APOE33+debris and APOE44+debris (legend key *p < 0.05; other brackets: APOE33 vs APOE33+debris ***, APOE44 vs APOE44+debris ns, APOE33 vs APOE44 ns), and the means read ~5.05 vs ~5.13 on the 5.0-5.6 axis, so the APOE4-minus-APOE3 difference under challenge is ~dpH=0.08; n=3 wells is printed in the legend.

set.Finding description: In the female UCI5 isogenic pair, organoid-debris challenge lowered APOE33 microglial late-endosomal/lysosomal pH (about 5.30 to 5.24, * vs untreated in Fig 7M) but raised APOE44 pH (about 5.29 to 5.40, *** vs untreated); debris-treated APOE44 pH was about 0.17 units higher than debris-treated APOE33 (about 5.40 vs 5.24, read from Fig 7M), with three wells per group.
set.Data location: Fig 7M, UCI5 (33)+debris vs UCI5 (44)+debris (also each vs its untreated genotype)

why: Fig 7M (unpaired two-tailed t-tests per the legend) has a '****' bracket joining exactly UCI5 (33)+debris and UCI5 (44)+debris, key ****p < 0.0001, with means ~5.24 vs ~5.40 on the 5.2-5.5 axis (~dpH=0.17, APOE4 higher); no bracket joins the untreated pair, and n=3 wells is printed in the legend.
